title: Laptop with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- laptop base / keyboard deck -->
  <rect x='18' y='62' width='64' height='22' rx='4' fill='#3A6EA8'/>
  <!-- keyboard area -->
  <rect x='23' y='66' width='54' height='14' rx='2' fill='#5B9BD5'/>
  <!-- keys -->
  <g fill='#8DC6FF'>
    <rect x='25' y='67' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='34' y='67' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='43' y='67' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='52' y='67' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='61' y='67' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='70' y='67' width='5' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='25' y='72' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='34' y='72' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='43' y='72' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='52' y='72' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='61' y='72' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='70' y='72' width='5' height='3' rx='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- spacebar -->
  <rect x='36' y='77' width='28' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#B0D9FF'/>
  <!-- trackpad area lighter edge -->
  <rect x='38' y='63.5' width='24' height='1.5' rx='0.75' fill='#6FA8DC'/>

  <!-- hinge strip -->
  <rect x='20' y='59' width='60' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2A5A8F'/>

  <!-- laptop screen outer frame -->
  <rect x='20' y='14' width='60' height='47' rx='5' fill='#2A5A8F'/>
  <!-- screen inner display -->
  <rect x='24' y='18' width='52' height='39' rx='3' fill='#1A3A5C'/>

  <!-- smiling face on screen -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='34' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#7CE8FF'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='34' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#7CE8FF'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='32.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='32.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='42' r='3' fill='#FF9EBB' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='42' r='3' fill='#FF9EBB' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- big smile -->
  <path d='M36 42 Q50 54 64 42' stroke='#7CE8FF' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little smile dimples -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#7CE8FF'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#7CE8FF'/>

  <!-- camera dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='15.5' r='1.2' fill='#5B9BD5'/>
  <!-- camera indicator glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='15.5' r='0.6' fill='#7CE8FF'/>
</svg>
